d: Some careers have more impact than others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking (CIB) is a markets-led, financing-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Through our international network, we connect emerging and mature markets, covering key growth areas. We partner with our corporate, government and institutional clients to help them achieve consistent, long-term performance. Our products and services include advisory, financing, prime services, research and analysis, securities services, trading and sales and transaction banking.

Securities Services provides robust and reliable solutions that enhance performance and mitigate risk, today and in the future. Working with institutional investors, banks, insurance companies, governments and multinational corporations, Securities Services offers a range of fund administration, global custody, sub-custody and clearing, and corporate trust and loan agency services.

We are currently seeking an ambitious individual to join our Securities Services Team as a Business Manager will support the effective day-to-day management of MENA Securities Services, working with the Business Head, business management colleagues and country and regional functions.
q: Relevant experience in business management, financial analysis or business support within banking or financial services.

Strong Excel, Word and PowerPoint skills, with proven ability to maintain accurate management information and reliable records.
Strong communication, stakeholder coordination, organisation and attention to detail, with working knowledge of operational risk, internal controls and change management.

d: Lucidya is an AI-native platform for customer experience (CX) intelligence that manages entire customer lifecycles autonomously, from initial engagement through retention and growth.

Unlike platforms that only surface insights and leave the action to you, Lucidya completes the loop with proprietary NLU capabilities developed entirely in-house and trained on millions of multilingual conversations, equipping marketing, support, CX, and research teams to deliver personalized experiences that drive measurable improvements in customer satisfaction, retention, and lifetime value.

As a Client Delivery Specialist, you will be the on-site representative of Lucidya at our clients’ offices, responsible for managing and coordinating the delivery of assigned client projects. You will work closely with client stakeholders and internal Lucidya teams to ensure smooth execution of project activities, timelines, and deliverables.

This is a hands-on, project-based role (1 year) where you will be embedded with a specific customer (on-site at their office), overseeing day-to-day coordination, tracking progress, addressing challenges, and ensuring that all project outcomes and deliverables are delivered as agreed. You will play a key role in maintaining strong working relationships with clients and ensuring high-quality delivery across all assigned projects.

d: WSP is a renowned consultancy in the construction industry, specializing in site supervision for road, tunnel, highway, and bridge projects. With a commitment to excellence and innovation, we deliver high-quality solutions that meet the needs of our clients while adhering to the highest standards of safety and sustainability.

We are currently seeking a highly experienced Senior Road Engineer to join our team in Riyadh. The ideal candidate will have a minimum of 15 years of experience in road engineering, with a proven track record in site supervision within the construction consultancy sector. As a Senior Road Engineer at WSP, you will lead and oversee the successful delivery of road infrastructure projects, leveraging your technical expertise and project management skills to drive excellence and innovation.
q: Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or related field. Master's degree preferred.
Minimum of 15 years of experience in road engineering, with a focus on site supervision within the construction consultancy sector.
Professional engineering license or equivalent certification preferred.
Extensive knowledge and experience in road design, construction, and maintenance, with a deep understanding of relevant standards, codes, and regulations.
Proficiency in computer-aided design (CAD) software and road engineering analysis tools.
Strong project management skills, with the ability to lead and motivate multidisciplinary teams, manage project budgets and schedules, and deliver successful outcomes.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build positive relationships with clients, stakeholders, and team members.
Proven track record of successfully delivering road infrastructure projects, with a focus on safety, quality, and innovation.
Fluency in English; Arabic language skills would be advantageous.
As well as rewarding you with competitive pay, WSP offers standard benefits including first class medical cover, paid professional subscriptions.

r: Lead the planning, design, and development of road infrastructure projects, including alignment studies, geometric design, pavement design, and drainage design, in accordance with client requirements, regulatory standards, and industry best practices.
Conduct feasibility assessments, traffic impact analyses, and risk assessments to inform design decisions and optimize project outcomes.

Provide technical oversight and guidance during the construction phase of road projects, conducting regular site inspections to monitor progress, quality, and compliance with engineering specifications and contractual requirements.
Implement robust quality assurance and control measures to ensure that construction activities are executed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with approved plans and standards.
Develop and implement traffic management plans and safety measures to minimize disruptions and ensure the safety of road users, construction workers, and the public.
Monitor traffic flow, signage, and temporary diversions, and proactively address any issues or concerns to maintain smooth and safe operation of roadways during construction.
Engage with clients, stakeholders, regulatory authorities, and communities to understand their needs, concerns, and expectations related to road infrastructure projects.
Facilitate effective communication and collaboration among project stakeholders, providing regular updates, progress reports, and technical presentations to ensure transparency and alignment.

Manage project budgets, schedules, and resources effectively, tracking progress, identifying risks, and implementing mitigation strategies to ensure timely and cost-effective delivery of road projects.
Coordinate with multidisciplinary project teams, consultants, contractors, and suppliers to achieve project objectives and deliver high-quality outcomes that meet or exceed client expectations.
